sources.publisher: Information and Data Protection Commissioner, Albania
sources.supports: Articles 23 (information), 30 (presumption of innocence), 47 (peaceful unarmed assembly), 80 (ministerial replies to parliamentary questions and interpellations within three weeks).

visualMethod: Two qualitative diagrams: an original evidence checklist and a concise source-linked constitutional reference. The three-week deadline is reproduced from Article 80, with no claim that this clip starts the clock or establishes a breach.

meaningEvidence: Recovered submitted original MP4 has the exact SHA-256 of the approved source linked to the verified native TikTok publication.

Full Albanian audio transcription, original poster, contact sheet and sampled frames establish the parliamentary confrontation, its allegations and demands for accountability, plus the challenged person asking what he stole.

Visible Agron Shehaj and Partia Mundesia credits and the creator caption identify the shared exchange; the matching contemporary press report corroborates the participants as Agron Shehaj and Edi Rama.
The creator caption explicitly says Eduard does not personally know Agron Shehaj and praises the courage to confront power; first-person statements are restricted to this publication reaction.
limitations: The recording is an excerpt, not the full parliamentary session or a complete evidence file.
Criminal accusations, predictions of imprisonment and claims about public opinion are the speaker’s statements; the article does not certify them.
An original session date is not independently established from a primary parliamentary record and is not asserted. 18 October 2026 is only the verified TikTok repost date.
The camera mainly shows Edi Rama; the poster does not depict Agron Shehaj delivering the remarks. Thumbnail alt and video metadata preserve this distinction.
No claim is made that a formal Article 80 question or interpellation was initiated or answered in this exchange.
